palette_validation.result: The fixed status colours (critical #d03b3b, serious #ec835a, warning #fab219, neutral #898781, good #0ca30c) fail the categorical gates (lightness band, chroma, warning-vs-serious separation); this is expected for a status palette.
palette_validation.mitigation: Status colours are never the only encoding: each bar is named on its axis, carries its value label and has a table view; each badge carries an icon and text.

graph.rendering: one focused neighbourhood at a time (default depth 2, node cap 120, shared prerequisites not expanded); never the full graph

performance.network: only same-origin requests for the evidence copies; no telemetry, fonts or CDNs
